name: Milind Patel
title: Senior Full-Stack Developer & Web Development Manager
summary: Senior full-stack developer and web development manager with 10+ years of experience building complex, high-availability web systems with C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, React, and SQL Server on Azure and AWS. At Rexall, architects and maintains 8 applications and 12 API integrations, leads a team of 3 in-house and 2 vendor developers, and leads PCI DSS remediation and evidence preparation across four consecutive successful annual assessments. Builds Claude-powered AI agents that the team uses for complex engineering work.

experience.title: Web Development Manager
bullets: Own architecture and delivery for 8 applications (5 customer-facing, 3 internal) and 12 API integrations — Angular and React front ends, ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET (.NET Framework) back ends, SQL Server, and Magento — authoring design documents and impact analyses for cross-application changes.

Built Claude-powered AI agents that the team now uses for complex, multi-step work — cross-application impact analysis, legacy-code refactoring, test generation, and PCI evidence preparation — and wrote the team's prompt-engineering guidelines.
Lead a blended team of 3 in-house and 2 vendor developers through architecture and design reviews, PR reviews, sprint planning with Product, and vendor and security assessments.

Lead PCI DSS v4.0.1 work for the Magento, .NET, and React applications — remediating vulnerability-scan findings (OWASP Top 10), enforcing secure coding, and preparing assessment evidence — extending four consecutive successful annual assessments across both Rexall roles.
Troubleshoot complex production issues across application, database, and network layers with Azure Application Insights, and partner with the networking team on DNS, SSL/TLS, and firewall changes.

experience.title: Lead Developer
bullets: Designed a resilient integration layer — an ASP.NET Core Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) API for the Angular and React front ends, with retry, timeout, and circuit-breaker policies for internal and third-party APIs.

Led the incremental modernization of legacy ASP.NET (.NET Framework) applications to ASP.NET Core, separating tightly coupled modules into independently deployable services using Dependency Injection, the Strategy pattern, and layered architecture.

Set up containerized ASP.NET Core services on Kubernetes behind load balancers — deployments, liveness and readiness probes, and Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules — to keep sites available during releases and traffic spikes.
Delivered map-based location and address features with the Google Maps JavaScript API and Geocoding API, caching geocoded results within Google's 30-day limit to control API usage and cost.
Integrated payment token providers for checkout, building the payment integrations as in-scope PCI DSS components that meet its secure-coding and audit requirements.
Built full-stack features with Angular 12, React 18, and ASP.NET Core, and resolved database bottlenecks by rewriting complex T-SQL stored procedures, adding indexes, and tuning execution plans.
Remediated PCI DSS findings and prepared assessment evidence through the transition from PCI DSS v3.2.1 to v4.0, with every annual assessment successful.
Owned source-control integration, releases, and production patches through Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and provisioned Azure and AWS components for a secure cloud environment.

experience.title: .NET Developer
bullets: Designed and developed full-stack web applications with Angular 11 and .NET 5 Web APIs across the full SDLC in an Agile team.
Built an event-driven integration on RabbitMQ, with message consumers and scheduled SQL jobs generating downstream data, decoupling upstream systems from reporting workloads.
Implemented system-wide audit logging with SQL triggers and stored procedures, and extended Kendo UI for Angular components to speed up UI delivery.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Translated user stories into automated process flows on the DST AWD (Automated Work Distributor) BPM platform with Product Owners and Scrum Masters.
Built rule-driven document-filtering automation with XML logic and ASG Mobius Document Direct, and ASP.NET C# interfaces for internal applications.
Built reusable SSIS ETL packages and parameterized stored procedures that load flat-file, Excel, and XML data into SQL Server for reporting.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Built Angular front ends on ASP.NET Core Web APIs, and designed, built, and tested IBM Business Process Manager 8.5 process definitions from requirements gathered with business analysts.

experience.title: Senior Software Developer
bullets: Architected and built a multi-module School ERP platform on ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core Web API, Angular, and SQL Server that automated school back-office workflows.
Owned client requirements, estimation, and delivery tracking, and mentored junior developers through code reviews.
